$Comment: The Mastery Trainer's board of lessons, drawn once a day at midnight UTC, one contract per slot. A slot
posts only contracts whose Boards entry names its Difficulty band: Mastery_Gathering (logs, ore, fish),
Mastery_Fighting (creatures, abilities), Mastery_Crafting (the benches), Mastery_Hard and
Mastery_Master. The lessons sit in Bounties/MMOSkillTree/Mastery/ on Mmo_Lesson_Base.
Standing with the trainer opens more of the board. The Gathering and Fighting slots are open to
everyone; the others carry Requires on a rank (ziggfreedcommon:reputation_rank, Param
Mmo_Mastery_Trainer/<rank>, Min 1): the Crafting slot at Friendly (Student), the Hard slot at Revered
(Adept), a Master's slot at Exalted (Master) and a second Master's slot at Mastery_Trainer_Tier_3
(Grandmaster). Everyone sees them posted, and a player below the rank sees them locked, with the
reason. Each of those slots is Optional, so a band left empty shows no gap. The Master's band holds
three lessons, so its two slots post two different ones.
Requires: the mastery feature at the top decides whether the board exists at all, and finishing A
Word with the Trainer or What You Already Paid (AnyOf, quest_completed meet_the_mastery_trainer or
mastery_tithe_credit) is what lets a player take anything off it, so a player who paid the Mastery
Tithe is never left at the trainer with nothing to do. Where keeps it in the Forgotten Temple: anywhere else it is left out of every list and opens
closed. The trainer's conversation opens it. Grades names each band for the badge on its rows:
TitleKey is its words, Color the badge's colour. Currencies shows the two wallets a lesson pays into.
Every lesson's pay waits here until the player collects it (Rewards.Claim).
To add a lesson, ship a contract that names Mmo_Mastery_Lessons and one of these bands in its Boards.
